_comment: Sub-task segmentation for chained tasks, consumed by scripts/diag_dataset.py --phases-json.
Ranges are [start_frame, end_frame_exclusive, label] within ONE episode, frame indices
as stored in the dataset's frame_index column.
Why this matters: if the same observation appears in two different phases and requires
different actions, the policy cannot learn both. Labelling each frame with its CURRENT
sub-task gives the policy an explicit phase variable and is the single highest-value fix
for 'it only does the first motion'. See the Troubleshooting section of the README.
Segment boundaries do not need to be perfect -- they need to be consistent. If you are
segmenting by hand, use the moment the gripper state changes or the object starts moving,
and apply the same rule to every episode.
